Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The South Africa fielders stride out to the middle. Minod Bhanuka and Avishka Fernando walk out to bat. Kagiso Rabada to start with the ball.
Or you could switch tabs and enjoy the T20I between Zimbabwe and Ireland. Whatever suits you, but make sure to keep an eye out for updates here.

Meanwhile, in London, the Indian batters are batting really well. They have taken their lead to 80 runs now but more importantly, they have lost only one wicket. Rohit Sharma is inching closer to his ton while Cheteshwar Pujara is getting close to his 50. While the players take a break here, you can switch tabs and enjoy our coverage of the fourth Test between India and England!

Can Sri Lanka chase this down? A target of 284 in 47 overs is not a small one and Sri Lanka will have to bat well. Their batting has improved quite a bit since when they toured England so this should be an interesting battle. Do join us in a short while to find out what happens.

Sri Lanka were put under the pump with the ball. They started well and Chamika Karunaratne got the big wicket of Aiden Markram at the start. But after that, the stand between Malan and Hendricks did not allow Sri Lanka to build on that early wicket. The hosts used 7 bowlers but none of them were exceptional. Dushmantha Chameera took 2 wickets but he was quite expensive, especially in the death overs. Dhananjaya de Silva bowled quite well and got a wicket and so did Wanindu Hasaranga, but he was a touch expensive. The pick of the bowlers was Chamika Karunaratne as he got two wickets and gave only 24 runs from his 5 overs.

Janneman Malan was the nucleus around which the South African batting revolved. First, Malan and Aiden Markram provided a good start but Markram fell soon. Then came the big stand between Malan and Reeza Hendricks. They batted for a long time and set the platform for South Africa. Hendricks fell after getting a 50. Rassie van der Dussen came out to bat but could not do much after getting a start. Malan was now joined by Heinrich Klaasen and both of them turned the innings on its head. Boundaries came thick and fast and South Africa were racing towards a big total. Klaasen scored at a strike rate of almost 160 and raced to 43. While all this was happening, Malan was struggling with cramps but he carried on and got to his ton. Both these batters fell in the 45th over but they had done their job well enough.

Well, that was an entertaining passage of play. South Africa have batted really well and have put on a competitive total on the board. Their batting was much better than what it was in the first game. They have finished the innings quite well and have the momentum going into the break. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will be quite disappointed with the way they bowled in the last few overs.

Two to end! A really good last over for South Africa! A short one and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket. It is away from the fielder and a couple of runs are taken. South Africa END WITH 283!
Full and on middle, Mulder whips it through square leg for one.
Two completed with ease! Shorter and on middle, Mulder pulls it down, he actually taps it down to long on gently for two.
Just the single! Cramps the batter for room by bowling it on the body, it is hit down to long on for one.

Two! Well done in the end! Chamika Karunaratne it is! A full toss, Linde just looks to time it. He gets it off the middle towards sweeper cover but since it is the longer side, it does not have the distance. Chamika Karunaratne takes it as he moves back, then realizes the momentum is taking him over the ropes so throws it back in. Saves four for his side.
WIDE! Make that 6! A slower one but it is well wide outside off. Left alone.

FOUR! Lovely stroke! Off the mark in style in ODI cricket! Picked his spot well. Did not try to hit it too hard. This is full and outside off, Linde lofts it over mid off for a boundary. 5 from the first ball then.

NO BALL! Chameera has overstepped! Not the start Lanka wanted in the last over. Especially when things were going well for them again. It is well wide outside off. Linde looks to go over covers but misses. Free Hit coming up.
George Linde walks out to bat on his debut. He will face Dushmantha Chameera, who is on a hat trick.

OUT! TAKEN! This is a brilliant penultimate over from Chamika Karunaratne! Just the 6 from it and a wicket too now! Another short one, this one skids through. Phehlukwayo looks to pull, he is hurried onto the pull shot. It goes off the splice and lobs back to the bowler who takes it. Sri Lanka finishing strongly here.
Two more! On middle, this is heaved towards deep mid-wicket by Andile Phehlukwayo. Two taken. Still no boundaries in this over.
Just the 4 from the first 4 then! Another slower one, fuller and outside off, this is also hit really hard but down to long off for only one.
Just three from the first three balls! Another slower one, it is hit down to long off for one more.
Hit hard but only for one! Fuller and on off, this is hit to long off for a single.
Just the one! Singles won't harm the Lankans! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Wiaan Mulder walks out to bat. Also, Chamika Karunaratne (4-0-18-1) is back on.

OUT! LBW! No bat on that one and three reds on Ball Tracker. So, after a marathon knock, Malan departs! He has done his job though and should be very proud of his knock. Full ball, on off. Malan goes for the reverse paddle but misses and is hit on the pads. The umpire raises the finger right away. Malan reviews this but he knows that he is out and starts walking. There is no bat on that one and Ball Tracker shows three reds. He walks back to a well-deserved applause from his team.
Who will bat now? As Heinrich Klaasen walks off, the physio is out in the middle as Malan is in need of some stretching. Andile Phehlukwayo walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Klaasen has to walk back but not before playing a gem! We did mention he needs to play a cameo for his side and he has done so. Lanka though will be slightly pleased as there are still another 13 balls to go and this could well make a difference of 10 runs to the final total. On middle, Klaasen looks to go downtown. It goes more off the bottom and Shanaka at long on, runs ahead and takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! This time he connects and connects really well! Short and on middle, it is a slower one. Klaasen pulls it hard, clears the square leg fence for a biggie.

Two more! Really poor fielding! Poor awareness too as he threw it at the wrong end. A full on middle, Klaasen swings, it goes more off the inner half through square leg. Two taken. The throw should have been at Malan's end. He is the one struggling but instead it is to Klaasen's end who made it in with ease.
Two dots! Yet another short one and on middle, Klaasen looks to pull but misses.
A slower short one, Klaasen is followed as he makes room. He swings but misses.

FOUR! Another misfield! This is really not good from Lanka! Malan plays the reverse sweep again, it is hit through point. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, gets to the ball but lets it through. This stand is taking away the game. A huge over.
SIX! Malan is on fire! That is huge! 250 up. You need not run if you can hit it that far. Another one tossed up on off, really full, this is nailed over the long on fence for a biggie.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Malan gets another boundary! Sri Lanka have been really sloppy in the field so far! This is tossed up on off, it is the googly, it is dragged towards wide long on. Charith Asalanka runs to his right, he gets two hands to it but spills it. To add to that, he gives away a boundary too.
Just the one again! Shorter and on middle, this is mistimed towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Really good fielding and only one! On middle, the reverse sweep is out, it goes towards deep point. The fielder runs to his left, dives and it is only one as Malan is struggling.
Oh no. The physio is out in the middle. The moment Malan hit the sweep shot. He went down in pain. He has been struggling with cramps for a while now.
Malan is down on the ground! He is struggling with cramps. The heat has got to him. On middle, Malan looks to sweep but it goes off the inner half to short fine leg.

Malan looks to be cheeky! Tries to play the reverse sweep, a slower one on off, it goes off the toe end towards point for one more. Three from the last three balls but the damage was done earlier on. 14 from the over.
Another one on the shorter side, this is pulled again through mid-wicket for one more.
Malan is limping as he completes the run! Short and on leg, it is pulled through square leg for one.
FOUR! That is brilliantly played! He walks across and aims to play the paddle scoop. Chameera goes for a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss, Malan gets it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.

A single and there is the ton for Malan! Take a bow, a really good innings from him. He has batted a tad slower than he would have liked but still, a really good innings. Has held fort at one end. Shorter and outside off, Malan looks to cut, it goes off the bottom edge towards point for one. He would now look to step up the ante.

FIVE WIDES! More bonus runs for South Africa! This is a poor start. Chameera bangs it way too short. Malan lets it be. It goes well over the keeper's reach and to the boundary. 5 runs and a single legal ball has not been bowled in this over.
Dushmantha Chameera (4-0-16-0) is back on.
Malan moves onto 99! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. So, just the 6 from the over despite a boundary on the first ball.
The googly, it lands on off and then turns back in. Malan looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Floats it up on middle, Klaasen looks to play the slog sweep, it goes off the inner half towards short fine leg for one.
Review time. Heinrich Klaasen has reviewed this LBW decision. He survives! The impact is outside off!

NOT OUT! The impact is just outside off! Heinrich Klaasen survives. He should be thanking Malan there. Klaasen was walking off but he was asked by his partner to review it and it turns out to be a good one. Hasaranga can't believe it! Slightly shorter, it lands outside off and then turns back in. Stays a touch low too. Heinrich Klaasen looks to pull but misses to get hit on the pads. A huge appeal and the finger is raised. Heinrich Klaasen starts walking off but then reviews. Replays show that the impact is outside off. He continues and this is what South Africa would have wanted. He is playing a superb hand.
Now looks to play the reverse sweep but this one is a little too full, it goes more off the glove to short third man.

FOUR! In the gap again! This is a blinder of a knock from Klaasen! Powerful shot too! Shorter and on middle, this is powered through mid-wicket. This one races away to the fence. Good start to the over. Pressure on Wanindu Hasaranga now.
Two to end! Malan moves onto 98. A really good over this one, courtesy that overthrow. On middle, this is hit between deep mid-wicket and long on for two.
Swept and swept hard again, but towards deep mid-wicket. Only one.
Flatter and on middle, Klaasen pushes it back to the bowler.
A slight halt in play. Janneman Malan is having some fluids. It is quite humid out here and he has batted for a long time.

SIX RUNS! That is poor! The long on fielder, Wanindu Hasaranga, was not expecting that. A short one and on middle, it is pulled through mid-wicket by Heinrich Klaasen. The fielder at mid-wicket runs to his left, he fields the ball and as he is falling onto the ground, he tries to lob it to the fielder from long on who is running to his right. Wanindu Hasaranga overruns it and it goes behind for a boundary. Welcome one. Releases some pressure off the two. It is actually signaled as six runs and that boundary is given as overthrows. This is massive. The batters had run two by the time the fielder looked to lob it back to the fielder. It is not a misfield or a fumble, it is an overthrow.
Plays the sweep, hits it hard through mid-wicket only for one as it is straight to the fielder.
On middle, tossed up. Turns away. The batter looks to defend but it goes off the outer half to point.
Another single to end! The googly, lands on off and turns back in. Malan looks to defend, it goes off the inner half to fine leg for one.
Beaten! This lands on off, a lot slower, pitches and then turns away. Malan is beaten.
Shorter again, this one also skids through. Klaasen looks to pull, it goes off the splice and towards long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this one skids through. Klaasen looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shorter and outside off, it is slapped through covers for one.
Slower and outside off, Klaasen looks to hit it hard, it goes off the inner half down to long on for one.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now 5 fielders can be outside the ring till the end of the innings!
Shorter ball, outside off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! That is some power by Heinrich Klaasen! Shorter ball, outside off. Pulled away. The fielders from long on and deep mid-wicket converge. But the ball bisects them and runs to the fence!
Loopy ball, outside off. Malan sweeps it across the line to deep mid-wicket for one. 200 up for South Africa.
Shorter ball, outside off. Malan chops it towards cover.
Flatter ball, around off. Blocked out.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Malan gets low and paddles it to fine leg for a couple.
Loopy ball, on leg. Malan gets the inside edge towards mid on for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Pushed past deep cover for one.
FOUR! Heinrich Klaasen now nails the sweep! Tossed up, on the pads. He sweeps it hard. The man at deep backward square leg gets to his left and dives but cannot get to the ball.
Loopy ball, on leg. Malan gets the inside edge to the leg side for one.
FOUR! He has played that shot really well today! Loopy ball, on the pads. Malan gets low and sweeps it hard to the square leg fence.
Loopy ball, on leg. Malan gets hit on the pads while looking to block.
Tossed up, on leg. Heinrich Klaasen sweeps it past deep square leg for another couple of runs.
Loopy ball, on leg. Blocked out.

A halt in play! It is not a good sight! Looks like that reverse sweep from Heinrich Klaasen hit a bird on its way and it is lying flat on the ground. It has to be taken off and a groundstaff does so. We are all set to resume.
Loopy ball, on leg. This time the conventional sweep is played by Heinrich Klaasen. The ball goes towards deep square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Nicely done by Klaasen! Loopy ball, on leg. He reverse-sweeps it to the third man fence.
Loopy ball, on leg. Swept to deep square leg for one.
Sharp turn! Loopy ball, on off. Malan is beaten as the ball turns past his attempted defence.
Shorter ball, on off. Heinrich Klaasen chops it back on the deck.
Heinrich Klaasen walks out to bat now! He can hit the ball a long way and a cameo is something his side would love here.

OUT! STUMPED! Wanindu Hasaranga gets the big wicket of Rassie van der Dussen. This is a huge moment in the game. Tossed up, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen misses the sweep and Minod Bhanuka takes the stumps off in a jiffy. The keeper is very confident and it is more of a celebration than an appeal. The TV umpire is called in. There is no bat on that and the replay shows that Rassie van der Dussen had dragged his back foot out of the crease.
Commentary.Howout: st Minod Bhanuka b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Stumping appeal! The keeper is already celebrating! That was quick work from the Minod Bhanuka.
Tossed up, on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to short cover.
Tossed up, on leg. Pushed to long on for one.
FOUR! That is nicely hit! Janneman Malan will look to up the ante now. He is set and needs to score a big one for his team. Tossed up, on off. Malan slog-sweeps it hard to the mid-wicket fence.
Shorter ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen works it towards deep square leg for one.
Wanindu Hasaranga (5-0-20-0) comes back on!
Tossed up, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen comes down the track and works it to deep square leg for a single.
An appeal for an LBW! Turned down! Lanka review. Seems to be pitching outside leg.

NOT OUT! Pitching outside leg. Loopy ball, around leg. Rassie van der Dussen misses the sweep and gets hit on the pads. The appeal for LBW is turned down but Dasun Shanaka reviews. There is no bat on that one but the ball is pitching outside leg.
Loopy ball, on off. Malan taps it towards cover for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it down the ground. The bowler dives to his left but cannot stop it. The ball goes to long off for one.
A sweep but straight towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off. Malan sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Pushed to covers.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Malan works it to deep square leg for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to deep point for one.
Nicely swept to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen backs away to the leg side and looks to punch. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards point for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Janneman Malan plays the reverse sweep. The man from short third man gets to his right and dives but cannot stop it. The fielder in the deep cuts it off and keeps it to three.
Uppish but safe! Loopy ball, on off. Malan punches it uppishly but towards long off for one.

Almost a wicket! That is well bowled. This lands on off and turns away sharply. Malan stays in his crease and looks to block but the ball goes past the outside edge. The ball goes just past the off pole.
Shorter again, outside off. Malan gets the outside edge while looking to cut. The ball goes towards short third man.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Worked towards mid on.
Flatter ball, outside off. Pushed towards cover.
Shorter ball, outside off. Malan goes for the cut but gets no bat on it.
Another single to end! On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

The physio is out in the middle as Janneman Malan is in need of some stretching. The umpires have decided to take DRINKS. Sri Lanka have bowled really well in the last few overs and have stemmed the flow of runs. That resulted in the wicket of Reeza Hendricks. South Africa now, need to rebuild and would want these two to bat for quite a while.

NOT OUT! Rassie is in! He did not back up a long way and was alert to the ball coming back his way. This is on middle, it is pushed back towards the bowler. Dhananjaya de Silva dives to his left, it flicks his hand and goes behind onto the stumps. An appeal. It is referred. Rassie van der Dussen is seen taking his gloves off and walking towards the right of the wicket. Not sure why, we thought he felt he was short. Replays show that he was well in. He was walking towards that direction because the guys carrying the drinks were walking towards him.
Is that a run out? Nope, Rassie van der Dussen is inside the crease.
Rassie van der Dussen sweeps, he does so hard but close to deep square leg for one.
Decent effort in the field! This reverse sweep is out, it is hit towards backward point who dives to his left and gets a hand to it. Keeps it down to one.
Quicker this time and on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Slower and on the pads, Malan is a little early in the sweep, it goes off the inner half towards short fine leg for one.
A good comeback from Praveen but that boundary spoils the over a little. Tossed up on middle, blocked.

FOUR! Nicely played! Good placement! Rassie van der Dusse makes room and Praveen Jayawickrama follows him but with a short one. This is whipped wide of mid on and it races away. Welcome boundary. This will make Rassie van der Dussen feel a lot better.
Malan plays the sweep again, once again it goes more off the top edge but lands safe in the square leg region. One taken.

Almost! That is a superb delivery! The arm-ball. This one comes in with the angle from outside off. Rassie van der Dussen is not sure whether to commit ahead to stay back, in the end he just looks to put bat on ball. It goes off the inside edge and towards fine leg for one. Had he missed that, Rassie van der Dussen was a goner.
Rassie walks right across, it is a full toss, Rassie plays it back to the bowler.

Sloppy work from the keeper and he apologizes straightaway! This is slower and outside off, Malan looks to drive but misses. The keeper does not move to his right and just takes his gloves there, it flicks it and goes towards short third man for one. Bye.
Drop and run! Dhananjaya de Silva continues to keep it tight! On off, Malan plays it towards cover for one.
Another dot! On middle, Malan works it to mid-wicket.
Fumble and a run! On the pads, the bowler follows Rassie van der Dussen as he makes room. He works it to mid-wicket. The fielder dives but does not stop it cleanly. It rolls towards mid on for one.
Another one on the pads, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Slower, Rassie comes down the track and pushes it towards mid off for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Another single to end! Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Rassie van der Dussen brings out the reverse sweep, it is his go-to shot, he hits it well through point for one.
Slightly shorter and outside off. Rassie van der Dussenlooks to cut, the ball comes slow off the surface. It goes off the under edge on the off side.
Flatter this time and on middle, Rassie stays back and keeps it out.
That has turned a long way! This is slightly short and outside off, it turns away a long way. Rassie van der Dussen looks to cut but misses.
Well fielded! Praveen Jayawickrama slows it up, lands it on off. It is pushed to the left of the bowler who dives and saves a run.
Another dot to end! On middle yet again, Malan works it to mid-wicket. This is a good phase for the Lankans. They have stemmed the run flow a little and also got a wicket.
Rassie is off the mark! Fuller and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle, Rassie works it to mid-wicket.
Rassie van der Dussen walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! There is the wicket Sri Lanka needed! Reeza Hendricks walks back! This was expected. He just slowed down to get to his half ton, once he got there, tried to up the ante but falls in the process. Steps out. Dhananjaya de Silva spots it and shortens the length a little. Reeza Hendricks makes the mistake of going against the turn as he tries to go over cover. The ball holds its line just a little, enough to go past the bat and hit the stumps. Timely wicket. Can Lanka now build on this?
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Dhananjaya de Silva fires it on middle, Hendricks works it through mid-wicket for one.
That is a beauty! Praveen Jayawickrama tosses it above the eye line, lands it on off and then gets it to turn away. Malan lunges and tries to block but is beaten.

Fifty for Reeza Hendricks! He has played with a lot of intent, slowed down just as he got to close to his fifty but one expects him to go back to his attacking style now that he has got to his milestone. He is set and needs to hang on for longer. Gets there by pushing this one through covers for one. Ensuring with this knock that his side is not missing their original skipper.
Angled into middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Malan guides it to point.
Off the outside edge! No slip in place! Tossed up outside off, Malan looks to drive, it goes off the outside edge as it turns away. Towards third man for two.
Make that 5 dots in a row! Malan looks to play the reverse sweep, he gets into position early, Praveen slows it up and bowls it very full. It is played to short third man.
4 dots in a row to end. Dhananjaya de Silva is managing to keep it tight so far. A yorker on middle, it is jammed out.
Yet another dot as this one is worked to mid-wicket.
Quicker and on the pads, RH works it to short fine leg.
Floats it up on off, Reeza eases it to long off and gets to the other end.
This time he pushes it past the fielder at mid-wicket and down to long on for one.
Flatter and on the pads, Malan works it to mid-wicket.
Another single to end! This is floated up well wide outside off, Malan looks to drive, it goes off the inside edge past the keeper for one.
Keeping the singles going! On middle, Reeza goes back and clips it towards mid-wicket for one.
In the air... safe! On middle, Malan looks to sweep again, it goes off the top edge, well wide of deep square leg. One taken.
WIDE! Quicker but down the leg side, Malan looks to flick but misses.
Top edge but safe! Slower and it lands outside off, Reeza looks to sweep, the ball bounces a touch extra. It goes off the top edge towards third man for one.
Nicely tossed up yet again and on off, Malan pushes it down to long off and gets to the other end.
Floats it up on off, Malan pushes it to covers.
A single to end! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.

Half an appeal from the keeper but he is the only one doing so! Slower again, it lands around leg and then straightens. Malan looks to sweep but the ball comes slow off the surface, he is through the shot. It hits him on the pads. Going down leg.
Slower through the air this time and on middle, blocked.
Another run! On middle, Hendricks flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Malan sweeps it through square leg, gets to the other end.
On the pads, Malan works it to mid-wicket.

Two to end! Clever batting! There is just one man in the deep on the leg side. Reeza plays the sweep, it goes off the top edge but away from the man at deep mid-wicket. Two taken. An expensive start by Praveen Jayawickrama to his new spell.

FOUR! That is a poor effort in the field! However, it was poor cricket from Sri Lanka all around! This is a short one on middle, Reeza pulls it through square leg. The man in the deep runs to his right, he dives but does so over the ball and it goes to the fence.
Now the quicker one, slightly shorter, it is pushed down to long on for one.

FOUR! That is a lovely shot! This is slower and lands on middle. Malan reaches out for it, he rolls his wrists over the ball, keeps it down and nails the sweep through mid-wicket. Gets to his fifty in style. A lovely knock so far but he needs to keep going for South Africa.
Nicely tosses this one up around off, it is pushed down to long off for one.
Bowled with a wide-arm action, it is angled into middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Six from Dhananjaya de Silva's first! On off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Very fine! On the pads. Reeza Hendricks looks to sweep, it goes off the gloves, between the legs of the keeper and down towards fine leg for two.
Gets this to angle away, it starts on middle and ends on off, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Easy pickings! On the pads, Malan flicks it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Another easy one! On the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.
Dhananjaya de Silva to roll his arm over now.
Slightly shorter, this lands, holds in the surface and then turns back in. Malan works it through square leg for one.
Full ball, on the pads. Malan drives it towards long on fo a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Punched towards point.
Slower ball, short of a length, on off. Malan punches it to cover.
FOUR! Malan is batting really well out there. Length ball, outside off. He cuts it hard past point. The ball races to the fence. There is a man in the deep but he has no chance.
Length ball, on off. Malan works it towards point. Wanindu Hasaranga gets to his left and stops the ball.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed towards point.
Darted on the pads. Reeza Hendricks gets hit on the pads while looking to flick.
Shorter ball, outside off. Janneman Malan goes back and punches it to long off for one. 100 up for South Africa.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Reeza Hendricks goes back and clips it past square leg for a single.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Malan drives it past covers for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks punches it to deep cover for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed to long off for one.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished by Reeza Hendricks! Length ball, down the leg side. He just helps it on its way to the fine leg fence. It is a slower ball but Shanaka got his line wrong.
Good fielding! Shorter ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks cuts it. The man at point dives to his left and stops the ball.
On a length, outside off. Malan looks to punch but gets the inner half of the bat towards long on for one.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Reeza Hendricks runs it towards third man for one.
FOUR! Smacked by Reeza Hendricks! Shorter ball, outside off. He pulls it hard. The man at short mid-wicket leaps up but the ball goes over him. It runs to the fence in no time.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Chamika Karunaratne draws the first blood! That is the big wicket of Aiden Markram. On a length, around off. Markam looks to drive it on the up but gets the outside edge. Minod Bhanuka takes an easy catch behind the stumps. The extra bounce gets the better of Markram there. He had to rise on his toes to cover up for it but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the keeper.
Commentary.Howout: c Minod Bhanuka b Chamika Karunaratne

We are set for the action! The fielders spread out on the field. Janneman Malan and Aiden Markram walk out to bat. Dushmantha Chameera to steam in.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper, he says that he would have batted first but there might be dew later on so he is fine with chasing. Adds that the team is very confident and the conditions favour them. Informs that they are unchanged.

Keshav Maharaj, the South African skipper, he says that he is feeling excited to captain the side and hopes that they can win this game. Adds that they have added a spinner in the side as they feel that it might get tough to bat later. Informs that Wiaan Mulder, George Linde and Reeza Hendricks come in the side.

PITCH REPORT - Farveez Maharoof is down for the pitch report. He says that the wicket is quite dry. Adds that the DLS method might come in play so the captain winning the toss might look to bat first.

Sri Lanka (Unchanged Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Minod Bhanuka (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Akila Dananjaya, Praveen Jayawickrama.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Aiden Markram, Reeza Hendricks (In for Temba Bavuma), Rassie van der Dussen, Wiaan Mulder (In for Kyle Verreynne), Heinrich Klaasen (WK), Andile Phehlukwayo, Keshav Maharaj (C), George Linde (In for Anrich Nortje), Kagiso Rabada, Tabraiz Shamsi.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of South Africa. The visitors will bat first!

Update 3 pm Local (9:30 am GMT) - We have news! The toss will take place at 3:30 pm Local (10 am GMT) and the play will start 30 minutes after that. But the match has been reduced to 47 overs per side.

Update 2:30 pm Local (9 am GMT) - Well the good news is that the rain has stopped. There is still plenty of water on the covers but the ground was entirely covered with covers. The groundstaff are hard at work and we are hoping for good news! Meanwhile, our coverage for Day 3 of the Test between England and India has started. You could switch tabs and take a look at that. We will keep bringing you more updates from Colombo as they come.

Update 1:55 pm Local (8:25 am GMT) - We have bad news folks! The ground is covered and there is water all over the covers. Grey skies are looming around and the toss is likely to be delayed. The latest tweet from Cricket South Africa does not paint a pretty picture. There is plenty of water on the covers and plenty of grey in the sky.

We saw in the last game, the Lankans went ahead with three specialist spinners and the South Africans played two. They used Markram as the third which turned out to be a good move. Will we see George Linde replacing Andile Phehlukwayo? Possible as the latter did not have the best of games in the first outing. South Africa will be without Temba Bavuma as he has been ruled out due to a fracture on the thumb and Keshav Maharaj will lead the side. So, there will be a forced change in their side and it will be interesting to see who comes in. As for the hosts, expect them to be unchanged and they are likely to stick to the winning combination.

After quite some time the Lankans enter a game with a chance of sealing the series. A similar performance to the first game will see them bag the series with a game to go. Not going to be easy though against a South African side that will be eager to keep it alive. Will we have a decider? We will find out. Welcome to our coverage of the second ODI between Sri Lanka and South Africa.
